Headline: Director at Premier Agric
Summary: Khanya Nyawo is the Managing Director of both Premier Agric and Badger Analytics, where he drives innovation and excellence in the agribusiness sector. With a passion for sustainable agriculture and data-driven solutions, Khanya has played a pivotal role in empowering farmers and agribusinesses across South Africa. Under his leadership, Premier Agric has provided top-notch training, mentorship, and capacity-building programs, while Badger Analytics delivers cutting-edge insights through advanced data analysis and AI.  Khanya’s vision for the future of agriculture centers on enhancing productivity, promoting sustainability, and fostering community development. His leadership is marked by a commitment to excellence, innovation, and long-term impact in the agribusiness landscape.
